item.title: Columbia breaks ground on new Olympia Fire Station 2
item.description: Columbia-Richland Fire Department breaks ground on a $10 million Fire Station 2 in Olympia, a 15,000-square-foot facility to support regional growth. The post Columbia breaks ground on new Olympia Fire Station 2 appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Cohn Construction completes GoAtlas HQ in Ridgeville
item.description: GoAtlas has opened its new 31,200-square-foot headquarters and production facility in Ridgeville, built by Cohn Construction to support expanded manufacturing and distribution operations. (Photo/Cohn Construction) The post Cohn Construction completes GoAtlas HQ in Ridgeville appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Greenville Literary Association launches adult entrepreneurship program
item.description: GLA starts a 12-week BUILD Your Future program teaching adults business skills, marketing, financial literacy and providing a U.S. Entrepreneurship Certificate. The post Greenville Literary Association launches adult entrepreneurship program appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Congaree Vista tops $475M in investment in downtown Columbia
item.description: Congaree Vista has secured more than $475M in investment, with mixed-use, hotel and public projects driving growth in downtown Columbia. The post Congaree Vista tops $475M in investment in downtown Columbia appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Crosspointe Plaza sold in Greenville retail corridor
item.description: Colliers arranged sale of Crosspointe Plaza in Greenville’s Haywood Road retail corridor, a 124,375-square-foot center leased to national tenants. The post Crosspointe Plaza sold in Greenville retail corridor appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: AI-driven productivity fuels faster U.S. economic growth
item.description: Surging productivity driven by AI is boosting GDP growth, lowering inflation pressure and raising potential U.S. economic growth to 3.0%. The post AI-driven productivity fuels faster U.S. economic growth appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Columbia Food & Wine Festival launches ticket sales for April 22–26 festival
item.description: Now entering its ninth year, the Columbia Food & Wine Festival has grown from a single tasting into a multi-day destination experience that reflects the energy and diversity of Columbia’s evolving food scene The post Columbia Food & Wine Festival launches ticket sales for April 22–26 festival appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: SC Manufacturing Madness seeks coolest product made in SC
item.description: South Carolina Manufacturing Madness returns for its fifth year, inviting public votes to choose the Coolest Thing Made in SC. Nominations open through Feb. 19. The post SC Manufacturing Madness seeks coolest product made in SC appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Clemson, MUSC Health break ground on campus medical facility
item.description: Clemson University and MUSC Health break ground on a 90,000-square-foot medical facility set to open in 2027, expanding student health and research services. The post Clemson, MUSC Health break ground on campus medical facility appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Mashburn Construction marks 50 years, plans move to Seaboard Vista
item.description: Mashburn Construction celebrates its 50th anniversary with plans to relocate its corporate headquarters to Seaboard Vista in Columbia by late 2026. The post Mashburn Construction marks 50 years, plans move to Seaboard Vista appeared first on SCBiz.
